text_block_list.text:
Lately, colds seem to be going around. Just as I was
thinking my own throat felt a bit scratchy—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh? Do you have a cold too?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I usually pride myself on being full of energy.
I wonder where I managed to catch it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Guess it can't be helped. Here, take this candy.
It's a magical throat drop I made myself♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's pitch black. But it kinda looks
like it'd really work. Thanks, down the hatch—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: GYAAAH!! What is this...?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It tastes like medicine, like rubber,
like a tire...?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, it's called liquorice candy.
In Europe, it's famous for soothing the throat.
Even if people in Japan say it tastes super gross♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but it really works, I promise.
So don't worry and eat up.

A pitch-black candy that tastes like rubber tires.
Just as I was thinking I'd rather not eat one—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you over there. You look like
you're about to sneeze any second. Eat this candy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Why do you look so shocked? I'm just looking out
for you. Come on, hurry up!

Since she said she was looking out for me,
I couldn't really brush her off...
Bracing myself, I popped the pitch-black candy into my mouth.

...!!
It tastes like medicinal herbs and feels like chewing on a tire!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Aha♪ That face means it's working like a charm!
choice_data_list: Yeah, in more ways than one...!
Yup, in more ways than one...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay?! Take deep breaths, okay?!
Here, breathe in, breathe out!

text_block_list.name: Passing Student A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Sweep-chan is at it again~!
It's that magical candy of hers, right?

text_block_list.name: Passing Student B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is that Trainer over there gonna be okay?
Their face is contorted so bad!

text_block_list.name: Passing Student B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, thought so~! I'll go grab some water.
By the way, it gets way worse if you chew it, so watch out!

Perhaps drawn by my obvious agony,
a small crowd of students had gathered around.
By the time I drank some water and finally calmed down—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, everyone looks much livelier
than when they were complaining about having colds.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grandma wasn't kidding when she called it
'magical candy'♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The one from just now.
Grandma, the great witch I respect most, told me
it's 'a treat that brings forth laughter.'

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Seeing everyone laugh cheered them right up, didn't it?
That's my magic at work♪
choice_data_list: (That's a wonderful way to look at it.)
(That's a wonderful way to look at it.)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you look like you could still eat more!
Alright, time for seconds!

A 'magic' that brings laughter to those around just by eating it.
I was starting to think that wasn't so bad after all, but—
...As expected, something that tasted terrible was still terrible!

text_block_list.name: Passing Student A
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you really shouldn't push yourself so hard!

text_block_list.name: Passing Student B
text_block_list.text:
Come on now, don't hold back,
you should drink some water~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph, with this, a cold won't stand a chance♪

Perhaps because my body remembered that foul taste just now,
I just couldn't bring myself to reach my hand out...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What's with your hands trembling like that?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped, then. As a special
extra treat, I'll let you off the hook this time.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So everyone, make sure you eat every last bit
of this Trainer's share too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Passing Student A
text_block_list.text: Huh... WE have to eat it?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Of course! Come on, hurry up~♪

text_block_list.name: Passing Student A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, no choice... Alright—
...Gross, it totally tastes like rubber~!

text_block_list.name: Passing Student B
text_block_list.text:
No way, it definitely tastes like tires!
And specifically ones that just drove on a highway!

text_block_list.name: Passing Student A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
That makes zero sense~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ehh, boring.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll just have to look
for someone else who wants to eat—
Kuku, hold on a moment, Sweep-kun.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I have completed a new research sample,
but alas, no one will consume it, perhaps hesitating at its flavor.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Thus, I wish to test a theory.
If consumed alongside another foul taste,
no matter how vile, one won't notice—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And this "All-Purpose Amino Capsule: Kusaya-kun"
can be ingested without any trouble whatsoever!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon, you really only come up with
the weirdest stuff. But—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That sounds super fun♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, then let us proceed, Sweep-kun!
A pincer attack from both sides!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Got it! Here we come~!

The two of them ruthlessly attempted to corner me as a tag team.
Calling upon Kitasan Black for help, I somehow managed to escape unharmed...
